overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating and evaluating three types of textual explanations (simple, conservative, unifying) for logistic regression model predictions. Evaluation was conducted via human study with 40 participants using Likert scales. No automatic metrics or LLM-as-judge evaluation was performed. The NLG task is explanation generation focused on explainable AI (XAI).
